flagGatedSelfTests.discoveryMethod: Reads build-census-v1-*.mjs source and selects process.argv.includes("--self-test") builders with assertions.
flagGatedSelfTests.currentFiveWritePosture: Static inspection found assertions/read-only self-test bodies; the gate restores only newly dirtied overlay paths and removes newly untracked paths if a builder writes one.

pf05SelfTest.syntheticRaster: One synthetic 72x72 PDF is written below os.tmpdir, freshRasterEvidence invokes Poppler to create temporary PNG output and font-cache data, and finally removes the temporary stage.
pf05SelfTest.chainDiscoveryCaveat: The current discovery regex recognizes process.argv.includes but not PF05's argv-parameter form, so PF05 is not among the five dynamically discovered builders. This is a gate-scope observation, not a capacity waiver.

arFocusedTest.write: Writes only reports/focused-self-test.json after its assertions; the existing report is 649 bytes and is retained.

incrementalBytes.pf05SyntheticRasterAccounting: Included within selfTestAndLogs; temporary PDF, PNG and font-cache data are removed before the self-test returns.

budget.interpretation: This is a conservative reservation using the committed pre-PF05 category limits plus a rounded AR report overwrite allowance; it is not a claim about the eventual byte delta or gate result.

preservation.scratchPolicy: Only reproducible self-test scratch is temporary under os.tmpdir; no required evidence is stored solely there.
